description: This Java class 'CurrencyUpdateResponse' represents a data transfer object used to encapsulate the response containing a list of currency codes. It includes JSON serialization annotations, Swagger schema annotations for API documentation, and Lombok annotations for reducing boilerplate code. The class also provides a deprecated method 'getChanges' that returns a map containing the currencies.

classes.name: CurrencyUpdateResponse
classes.description: A serializable Java data class used as a response object that contains a list of currency codes. It uses Lombok annotations for boilerplate code generation, Swagger annotations for API documentation, and Jackson annotations for JSON serialization. It also includes a deprecated method for backward compatibility.

methods.name: getChanges
methods.description: Deprecated method that returns a map with current currencies; intended for backward compatibility. It creates an immutable map containing the 'currencies' list.
